title: Nashville TN -Music Row
description:
Wanna get away?!  *Work From Home*  *Online Learning* Perfect location! Music City is waiting for you  
Enhanced Cleaning protocol by a Professional Company. Open Flr plan, designer kitchen, Gas FP, Outdoor living space. Walking distance to restaurants/bars.  Coffee, creamer & light snacks are provided for your convenience. Uber/Lyft usually arrive in 10 min & cost less than $15.   Consider travel insurance, airbnb.com /d /travel-insurance STRP#2018057902

The space
I use a Professional Cleaning Service to clean after each guests departure.  My Cleaning Service follows all recommendations from the CDC and uses EPA Certified multi-purpose disinfectant on all hard surfaces, steam cleans bathrooms, kitchen, floors, etc.  I have added 36 hours in between bookings to allow for thorough cleanings and to ensure the safety of all involved.  Hand Sanitizer available in kitchen

Living Room: 16x20 (Gas Fireplace)
Dining Room: 11x15 
Kitchen: 14x18 (Eat-In)  Table w/4 chairs and 2 extra chairs in the dining room
Bedroom 1:  15x15 King bed
Bedroom 2: 12x13 Queen bed
Bedroom 3: 12x13 Full bed
2.5 Bathrooms

Guest access
Guests will have access to bedrooms, living room, dining room, kitchen, bathrooms, front/back porches and outdoor space.   Garage, office, electronics closet and hallway closet will be locked.  This is our home, when you're not here, we are.

Other things to note
We do have neighbors and they want you to enjoy your stay as well , so no parties or loud noises and visitors of guests are not part of the rental agreement, any evidence of such may result in a fine.   The garage and office upstairs is locked and not part of your stay, this is our personal space.  Entry to the "electronics closet" is strictly prohibited and any evidence of such will result in a fine!!  Everything is already set up for your use.

Please take a moment to thoroughly read the House Rules.  It will help both of us.

Smoking is STRICTLY PROHIBITED INSIDE the house.  Any evidence of such will be considered a violation of "House Rules".  

We do have security cameras inside our home.  They ARE NOT active (they are unplugged) during your stay, please do not touch the cameras.

At times I may be able to grant early check-in or a late check-out,  please ask in advance.  Please consider purchasing Trip Insurance
